description:
A sleek, panther-like six-legged predator with three pairs of clawed legs, a feline tail, and two barbed tentacles rising from its shoulders. Its current original-game template records no carried items or wealth. The new combat art depicts a planted ready stance followed by a forward, open-mouthed bite.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - READY:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ready frame for OpenGold combat sprite MON7CHA.DAX:68/default; later exported to 128x128 transparent PNG.
Primary request: Draw one original Displacer Beast as a muscular black panther with purple highlights, facing RIGHT in a low, long stalking guard. It has precisely THREE PAIRS OF LEGS: two hind legs under the rump, two middle legs under the belly, and two front legs under the shoulders. Count the image: exactly SIX distinct legs and SIX separate paws touching a single ground line. The foremost pair is behind the head; NO leg grows from the neck or under the head. Its long feline body connects all six limbs. Add ONE normal feline tail and exactly TWO long barbed-pad tentacles growing upward from the shoulders. Broad feline head, pointed ears, alert golden eyes, muzzle and whiskers, closed snarling mouth.
Composition: wide side / slight front-three-quarter view. Leave clear transparent space to the right of the nose so the action frame can thrust its head forward and open the jaws. All paws planted. Low body with no squashing; keep tentacles compact enough for a 2-wide by 1-high combat-square silhouette. No drawn grid. Entire creature and every tentacle tip visible with transparent outer margin.
Style: crisp classic fantasy game pixel art, large readable shapes rather than fine painting, high contrast silhouette at tiny 128x128 use. Real transparent background.
Constraints: ONE image, ONE creature, exactly six legs/six paws/two shoulder tentacles/one tail. No seventh paw, neck limb, extra tentacle, armor, weapon, rider, scenery, spell effect, ground shadow, text, border or sprite sheet. Invent the design independently; do not copy official D&D or original game art.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - ACTION:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: action frame for OpenGold combat sprite MON7CHA.DAX:68/default, exported later as transparent 128x128 PNG.
Input image: the new six-legged Displacer Beast ready image is the EDIT TARGET and exact visual identity reference. No original game art is supplied.
Primary request: Create the instant of a bite LUNGE toward SCREEN RIGHT. Extend the feline neck and head distinctly FORWARD relative to their position in ready, moving the nose roughly 6-8 percent of the full canvas width to the right while keeping the ears and nose fully inside the image. Lower and push the shoulders/upper chest slightly into the attack. OPEN THE MOUTH WIDE with separated upper and lower jaws, bright visible fangs and dark mouth interior. At 128x128 the action must read as a forward bite, not merely as a stationary roar.
Preserve: EXACTLY SIX legs and six distinct paws in three pairs. Every planted paw must stay at the same x/y location as in ready, as must the rear body, pelvis, belly, tail base, camera scale and ground line. Retain two separate shoulder tentacles with barbed pads, a normal feline tail, black-violet fur, gold eyes, and rightward facing. Keep neck, shoulders and chest smoothly connected to the original torso with no severed seam. The entire animal must not slide, rotate or shrink.
Composition: ONE full-body animal, low and wide, matching the ready image's canvas origin; this is a single action animation frame, not a sprite sheet. The body fits two combat squares wide and one high. Use the available transparent room in front of the ready head for the bite. Genuine transparent background.
Avoid: extra legs or paws, ghost duplicate, magic beam, weapons, gear, armor, scenery, text, ground shadow, border, opaque background, a closed mouth, backward head movement, or detached upper body.
